Later model reasons conflate the two earlier Attempts as EPRNMR failures, although the first did not start ORCA. The review separates them.
The penultimate model called evidence.text on method_notes.md while its reason described inspecting the candidate ORCA input.

The generated report leads with failed/partial and does not claim shielding success. Its stop diagnosis still shows the earlier corrected method-source hash proposal rejection; that stale label is not the final ORCA failure mechanism.

The final delivery still says the method notes are being prepared and numerical settings await input, although the notes and three input versions exist. These Plan-gap descriptions are stale, not a factual inventory of missing files.

The final delivery line 40 correctly says the prepared geometry is checked input without scientific qualification, but its generic Result output row at line 104 labels prepared_geometry scientific qualification True. This terminology conflict does not establish any NMR scientific output.

The method note says no random-number method is required for current geometry preparation; the actual preparation source instead reports random_seed=null and no exposed seed.
